avis.texte: I used this cleanser for several months. Mind you, I've never had "rosacea, or redness" on my cheeks. Well, after long use I either have one of both. I can most definitely inform you that this has damaged my skin barrier. I do not recommend this if you actually have "senstive skin"

I bought this during Ulta's sale and sad to report that it doesn't clean at all, it doesn't remove makeup, and it just stays on my skin like a lotion. After I wash it off, it just feels like I didn't wash my face. I used it to clean a makeup brush that I use powder on and nothing came off, it just made the powder stick more to the brush. That was concerning, I wish I could return it but I waited to use the product.

Love that you can wipe or rinse off. No need to worry about residue. Very kind to my sensitive skin.
I got the smallest size and even though it is small it has lasted me over a month! A little goes a long ways with these products so even if they are a little pricey they last and work!!

avis.titre: My skin feels and looks much more moisturized

I have rosacea on my face. This is the only face cleanser, I found that doesn't flare it up. I have used it for over a year. Love it
This is such a gentle cleanser and it keeps my skin soft and flawless.

I swear by this stuff! I tend to have pretty sensitive skin and sometimes starting new face products cause my skin to flare up, but there was none of that with this. Paired with the ultracalming serum, this stuff has worked wonders on my skin! I feel so much more confident and feel like I'm really taking care of my skin with this product.
this is doing nothing for me. removes zero makeup. my skin still feels filthy after two washes. I've bought this for years and it seems totally different.

I like it but sometimes feels like I don't put enough on even tho I do.

I started a skin care routine, but i really felt the difference once i started to use this as my first step. My face drastically cleared up! I use this before i go in with my biore cleanser that is meant for combination skin. Im so happy i bought this during the 21 days of beauty.
I use this product daily and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin

Dermalogica's UC cleanser (and all their products I've tried!) is a product I'll always purchase! My skin feel so clean, soft, and still hydrated after my morning cleanse! So happy I restocked during 21 DOB!
I've been using this product for years and rely on it to calm my slight rosacea. It's soothing and cleanses my skin. I follow up with smoothing lotion from dermologica.
This is my go to face wash every morning and night. Great feel and leaves my face clean and smooth.

I have cystic acne and sensitive skin and this is my miracle wash

Im so mad I soent almisr $70. It makes my skin so red and dry

I use a lot of brand fm cheap okay to expensive LaMer, but when the skin problems come back I always back to Dermalogica, I learn my lesson and stick with this brand !!!

Great for my sensitive skin. 41 years old never looked so good.
Absolutely love this product. It is a part of my daily routine.

Love the fact that you can wipe it off without water. Really feels like I just washed my face!

avis.titre: Long time user of this product

I would buy this product again, I love how soft and supple my skin feels after use.

Love love love this cleanser! MN winters are harsh and our skin needs extra TLC which this provides. Great for sensitive skin prone to redness. This was recommended to me over 15 years ago while getting a facial on vacation in FL and I've been using it ever since! Pea to dime size amount is all you need so it is worth the extra $$ as the bottle lasts a long time.

I've been using this cleanser morning and night for the past month and my skin i absolutely loving it! No dryness, soothing, and my skin has no reaction. 10/10

avis.titre: Finally found something that cleared my hormonal acne
avis.texte: Since high school, I have only used Noxzema - which did work as well as it could but wasn't really addressing the stubborn hormonal acne I'd get every month around my period. I'd get painful cystic-type acne around my chin like clockwork. A little over a year ago I went to get a facial and they used the Dermalogica Ultra Calming products on me. I bought it to take home and at first my skin purged but after 2 weeks I noticed my skin was clearer than ever and has been since! I can't even remember the last time I had any acne around my chin (or anywhere else really). I only use the Ultra Calming Cleaner and the Calm Water Gel Moisturizer. I use both in the morning and again before bed, only using The Ordinary Caffeine Serum on my under-eyes otherwise. Couldn't recommend these products enough!
I love this cleanser. You get a good size bottle for the price and I only use a little bit at a time. The smell is gentle and it seems to help reduce reduce immediately.
This is great for my sensitive skin, which is prone to reactions. I use the precleanse first, and then I often mix this cleanser with the Dermalogica exfoliant and it feels great.

I like this face wash. Although I don't have sensitive face skin I have eczema on my neck and chest and unfortunately this is the only face wash that doesn't seem to aggravate it. I just wish it was slightly more cleansing or exfoliating. I have acne prone skin and feel like this wash doesn't get everything off of my face. I use a retinoid though so it helpful for washing without drying
I've been using this cleanser for 20+ years. It's the only thing that works for my sensitive skin.
I love this product. Feels so good when I massage it in and love the way my skin feels when done.
It took me forever to find a cleanser for my sensitive skin that was prone to hormonal breakouts but this is it for me. I've been using this with the micro exfoliation and it's a game changer.
The ONLY face cleanser i ever use! Especially after a long day to take off my makeup.
Such a gentle cleanser. This has been a staple in my skin care routine!

I have extremely sensitive dry skin. Here are my pros & cons (my opinion): Pros: the wash did not burn my skin Cons: price point, did not calm or address the reddness, has an odd scent, does not lather at all, does not remove makeup at all, even after multiple washes, does not deep clean skin, dries skin out.
I've tried many cleansers and this is the only one that does not activate my sensitive skin or gives me those little white bumps.
I use this in the shower, it is quick and easy and rinses of great. No overpowering smell. I love it!

User great product. It leaves your skin clean and smooth. definitely be purchasing this again!
